scripts.dev: uv run --with-requirements requirements.lock python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8001
scripts.check: uv run --with-requirements requirements.lock python -m ruff check . && uv run --with-requirements requirements.lock python -m mypy .
scripts.lint: uv run --with-requirements requirements.lock python -m ruff check .
scripts.build: uv run --with-requirements requirements.lock python -m compileall -q app
